The project is about building a secure, local-network-only Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for organizations. It allows companies to store, manage, and query internal documents, employee data, and projects securely. The system works completely offline within a local network, ensuring data privacy and zero internet dependency. It uses AI + vector search (RAG) to provide accurate, context-based answers from internal documents. It includes role-based access control (RBAC) so different users (Employee, HR, Founder, etc.) can only access authorized data.
